title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-118-26二模

items.zh: 公园的管理方张贴了新告示,呼吁人们文明遛狗。
items.en: The park authority posted a new notice calling on dog owners to walk their dogs in a civilized manner.

items.zh: 他打小就对海洋充满好奇,长大后竟真的成为了一名水手。
items.en: Curious about the sea from an early age, he went on to become a sailor.

items.zh: 推进市区老旧小区改造,既要扮靓城市“面子”,更要夯实民生“里子”。
items.en: When upgrading old urban neighborhoods, we should not only beautify the city’s appearance, but must also consolidate the foundation of people’s livelihood.

items.zh: 随着全球经济一体化的加深,许多企业发现自己正陷入一种境地:过度扩张的风险往往超过了潜在的获利空间。
items.en: With global economic integration deepening, many enterprises find themselves trapped in a situation where the risk of overexpansion tends to outweigh the potential for profits.
